_doc: agentii data-plane MCP server. The `agentii` server entry is canonical-enforced against contracts/mcp-canonical.json (scripts/check.py Check 13); `_tool_inventory` and prose are per-vertical and may vary. Host CLIs dedupe by 'name'. The MCP wraps the spec-019 Hono REST API at agentii-ai/apps/api/src/routes/, which itself queries Neon-hosted spec-022 schemas: gold.companies (1,146-ticker registry), gold.canonical_entities, gold.entity_aliases, gold.xbrl_facts, gold.rendered_statements, pipeline.sec_filings, pipeline.src_documents, pipeline.src_silver_pages, pipeline.earnings_calendar, knowledge.* (entity/domain/block surfaces). MCP tool names match spec-019 endpoint names per FR-011.

_tool_inventory._comment: All P0 tools from spec 023 FR-011 exposed as MCP tools. Each tool name == HTTP path under /v1/.
